exam.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant
exam.study_prerequisites: Applied accounting and Dynamics 365 Finance experience across general ledger, currencies, journals, cash and bank, tax, receivables, payables, budgeting and fixed assets, plus the ability to reconcile source documents, subledgers and vouchers to the general ledger.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Implement accounts receivable, credit, collections, and subscription billing
Implement and manage accounts payable and expenses

review.notes: Every August 14, 2026 subobjective is mapped to an accounting object, configuration, source document, subledger/voucher/ledger effect, control, reconciliation, evidence, failure or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover chart/dimensions/structures/tags/defaulting; ledgers/currencies/revaluation/layers/allocations; journals/Excel/batch/reversal/intercompany; cash/bank/payment/reconciliation/forecast/netting; close/consolidation/elimination/settlement/tax; AR/credit/collections/subscription billing/deferrals; AP/matching/payments/expenses; all three budgeting capabilities; and fixed-asset books/depreciation/acquisition/transfer/disposal. All 15 URLs are cataloged: 14 reachable and Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records the active 100-minute English/Japanese exam, free Practice Assessment, 48h30 official paths, four-day course, official labs, current product docs, and explicit freshness limits for Pluralsight, Udemy and the February 2023 MeasureUp product.

sources.title: Study guide for Exam MB-310: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant
sources.notes: Authoritative five-domain blueprint: skills measured as of August 14, 2026; no future update announced. The change log removes cost management and adds budget planning among major revisions.

sources.title: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate
sources.notes: Active intermediate credential; 100-minute exam in English and Japanese, free Practice Assessment, five official paths and no announced retirement.

sources.title: Set up and configure financial management
sources.notes: Twenty hours 23 minutes across 16 modules on the accounting foundation, journals, currencies, cash/bank, tax and periodic processes.

sources.title: Manage accounts receivable
sources.notes: Ten hours 12 minutes across eight modules on receivables, credit, collections, subscription billing and recognition; includes some cost-management-adjacent material removed from the August blueprint.

sources.title: Manage accounts payable and expenses
sources.notes: Nine hours 56 minutes across six modules; the official syllabus includes Project Operations expense integration as adjacent depth.

sources.title: Perform budgeting and forecasting
sources.notes: Three hours three minutes on basic budgeting, budget control and budget planning.

sources.title: Administer fixed assets
sources.notes: Four hours 56 minutes on asset configuration, books, depreciation and lifecycle transactions.

sources.title: MB-310T00-A Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant
sources.notes: Four-day official instructor-led course; five linked paths total 48 hours 30 minutes.

sources.title: MB-310 Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance labs

sources.notes: 103-question diagnostic released August 2020 and last updated February 2023; its public objectives include cost-management and other stale scope, so use only after mapping to the August 2026 blueprint.

findings.title: Condensed snapshot is not the complete objective text
findings.evidence: Previous 89 rows merge or paraphrase current 96 detailed bullets on the same August 14 baseline.
findings.recommendation: Archive old objective/status bytes and historical references, then accept canonical full text.
findings.resolution: Archive old objective/status bytes and historical references, then accept canonical full text.

findings.title: Financial tags now include a validated fixed-list option
findings.evidence: 10.0.44 adds fixed-list entry validation; 10.0.49 procurement support needs its feature.
findings.recommendation: Teach version-specific behavior instead of absolute nonvalidation.
findings.resolution: Teach version-specific behavior instead of absolute nonvalidation.

findings.title: Dimension service retirement is narrower than dimension functionality
findings.evidence: September 11 deprecation concerns optional large DMF Ledger-import optimization.
findings.recommendation: Separate service scope from core account dimensions.
findings.resolution: Separate service scope from core account dimensions.

findings.title: Repeated revaluation can be overstated or duplicated
findings.evidence: GL uses the delta from its existing balance; subledger-revalued control accounts should be excluded.
findings.recommendation: Add original repeat-rate example and explicit scope controls.
findings.resolution: Add original repeat-rate example and explicit scope controls.

findings.title: Price agreement does not prove receipt agreement
findings.evidence: Three-way matching checks quantity against selected product receipts.
findings.recommendation: Add price-pass/receipt-fail example and separate tolerance types.
findings.resolution: Add price-pass/receipt-fail example and separate tolerance types.

findings.title: Amount matches can be ambiguous
findings.evidence: Default matching may choose the first matching document.
findings.recommendation: Teach reference criteria and manual-ambiguity review.
findings.resolution: Teach reference criteria and manual-ambiguity review.

findings.title: Payment journals change the eligible netting population
findings.evidence: Already-included payment transactions are outside the documented flow.
findings.recommendation: Run netting first and demonstrate residual/reversal evidence.
findings.resolution: Run netting first and demonstrate residual/reversal evidence.

findings.title: Equal periods and recognition posting are distinct controls
findings.evidence: Partial periods prorate and automatic journal posting may be disabled.
findings.recommendation: Make original schedule assumptions explicit and verify posted vouchers.
findings.resolution: Make original schedule assumptions explicit and verify posted vouchers.

findings.title: An active configuration does not enforce budget control by itself
findings.evidence: Turn On/Off is separate; history and document/formula scope matter.
findings.recommendation: Add activation distinction and reservation-to-actual example.
findings.resolution: Add activation distinction and reservation-to-actual example.

findings.title: Derived depreciation is copied rather than recalculated
findings.evidence: Different methods should not use derived depreciation to generate their amounts.
findings.recommendation: Use separate depreciation calculation in original two-book exercise.
findings.resolution: Use separate depreciation calculation in original two-book exercise.

findings.title: Historical release plans are no longer the new-feature disclosure source
findings.evidence: September transition directs new capabilities to AI at Work roadmap.
findings.recommendation: Add roadmap/product-document workflow and scheduled retirement check.
findings.resolution: Add roadmap/product-document workflow and scheduled retirement check.

blog_intake.author: Richard Riley
blog_intake.notes: Complete main August 25 article read. September disclosure transition and planned November 15 Release Planner retirement recorded with future verification; RSS/CSV existence does not mean this repo ingests them.

offline_checks: 35 assertions: allocations, FX deltas, matching, netting, recognition cutoff, reservations, asset books/disposal, elimination and catalog counts.

limitations: No Finance tenant, financial transaction, bank/payment file, customer/vendor message, tax filing, paid course or assessment execution.
Local assertions verify original simplified calculations, dates and public catalog counts; they do not prove Dynamics posting, accounting-policy compliance or localization correctness.
Long product pages read selectively; full regional, version, security, formula and feature matrices plus linked procedures not exhaustively audited.
Direct Udemy fetch blocked; indexed metadata is separate evidence. Assessment body empty and partner shell unreadable; O’Reilly/Whizlabs not comprehensively researched again.
Roadmap entries are estimates; interactive roadmap inventory and RSS/CSV feed ingestion were not implemented or verified. Scheduled review checks the planned November retirement.
Same-context AI review; independent human review and live lab evidence remain pending.

validation.execution_boundary: Local validation only; no infrastructure lab executed.
